title: Meaning in Context Practice 1
description: 4 short texts - 8 focused meaning in context questions
subject: rla
passage:
TEXT A - Reservoir Level

Engineers say the reservoir is stable this week: inflow from recent rain is roughly matching the amount released downstream.

TEXT B - Workshop Trial

The organizer called the first event a dry run for the larger conference planned in October.

TEXT C - Transit Card

The agency will phase in the new card system over three months, beginning with two stations before expanding citywide.

TEXT D - Data Review

The analyst warned that one unusual week could skew the monthly average.

questions.rule: Use the exact wording and surrounding context as evidence.
